timing_note: Primary frame_wall_ms covers Session::updateSource (copy, pose release) plus run; it excludes decode, comparison and JSON. total_ms is run only, the round-40 scope. Cold call 0 (Session construction) and warm-up calls are excluded from distributions. A faster method is named only when every paired block agrees with the pooled medians.
warmup_note: Sequence mode forbids warmup_seconds; warmup_calls per case were planned for 1.5 s at the faster round-40 median, and every process must show at least 1 s between the ends of call 0 and the last warm-up call.
memory_note: Peak process RSS, named Metal buffer lengths and pose-context buffers are separate scopes and are never added. Sequence RSS includes per-call decoding and the runner retaining every output row.
parity_note: Independent strict GT is evaluated on every cold, warm-up and measured call; exact same-method parity with the static control is a separate check.
frame_note: One archived fixture repeated: each updateSource copies a freshly decoded identical frame, so data-dependent work is unchanged; not a changing camera stream.
